_doc: 本体的前门问题。期望值不是抄编译输出：每条 `route` 是一段手写 SQL，闸门跑的时候才执行，把两条独立推导现场对上。三条 refused_by_names 是被声明的拒绝。行键 "None" 是 SQL 的 NULL 分组（未判定 / 原因未记录）—— 它是一根柱子，不是 0，也不是被丢掉的行。
_route_note: 比例和金额后面都加了 ::float8，理由实测过：闸门的比对是严格 `==`（gates/check_samples.py 的 check()），而 psycopg2 把 numeric 取回成 Decimal('0.94595923827510229777')，管线给出 float 0.9459592382751023 —— 两条路线在 17 位有效数字上一致，却因类型被判 FAIL。cast 成 float8 是让两条独立推导落在同一精度上对表，不是放宽标准：任何真实差异（例如管线把 0.9459 四舍五入）都会得到不同的 double。

expect.route: select count(*)::float8 from trips
select (count(*) filter (where on_time) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from stops
select (count(*) filter (where late_stop_count = 0) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from trips
select (count(*) filter (where load_weight > weight_capacity_snapshot) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from trips
select ((select sum(revenue) from trips) - (select sum(fuel_cost + toll_cost + driver_pay + handler_cost + external_fee + coalesce(other_cost, 0)) from trip_costs))::float8
select (1000.0 * sum(damaged_boxes) / count(*))::float8 from stops

samples.question: 按线路版本看超载率（重量）

expect.route: select route_version, (count(*) filter (where load_weight > weight_capacity_snapshot) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from trips group by 1
select sum(amount)::float8 from complaints where amount is not null
select (count(*) filter (where liability is null) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from complaints
select liability, count(*)::float8 from complaints group by 1 order by 2 desc
select (count(*) filter (where reason is null) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from refusals
select reason, count(*)::float8 from refusals group by 1 order by 2 desc

samples.question: 迟到站点占比（用趟次列复算）

expect.route: select (sum(late_stop_count) * 1.0 / sum(actual_stops))::float8 from trips
select (count(*) filter (where service_status <> 'delivered') * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from stops
select (count(*) filter (where axle_overload) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from trips
select (count(*) filter (where axle_overload or planned_stops > 15) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from trips
select (sum(load_weight) / sum(weight_capacity_snapshot))::float8 from trips

expect.route: select (count(*) filter (where not permit_valid) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from trips where core_restricted
select count(*)::float8 from trips where core_restricted
select (count(*) filter (where status = '有效') * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from zone_permits
select (count(*) filter (where restricted) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from restriction_calendar
select (count(*) filter (where status = 'attended') * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from driver_schedule where scheduled
select status, count(*)::float8 from driver_schedule group by 1 order by 2 desc
select (count(*) filter (where stops_delivered >= planned_stops) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from trips
select type, count(*)::float8 from incident_tickets group by 1 order by 2 desc
select count(*)::float8 from incident_tickets where is_primary

samples.question: 百公里油耗（油账 ÷ 里程）

expect.route: select (100 * (select sum(liters) from fuel_logs) / (select sum(actual_km) from trips))::float8
select v.tonnage, (100 * sum(t.fuel_liters) / sum(t.actual_km))::float8 from trips t join vehicles v on v.id = t.vehicle_id group by 1 order by 1
select ((sum(cost_total + maintenance_cost + fixed_cost)) / sum(actual_km))::float8 from trips
select ((sum(cost_total + maintenance_cost + fixed_cost)) / count(*))::float8 from trips
select sum(fine_amount)::float8 from violations
select category, count(*)::float8 from violations group by 1 order by 2 desc
select category, sum(cost)::float8 from maintenance_orders group by 1 order by 2 desc
select (count(*) filter (where planned_stops >= 16) * 1.0 / count(*))::float8 from trips
select (sum(stops_delivered) * 1.0 / sum(planned_stops))::float8 from trips
